title: mcp-sec-bench ground-truth manifest
description: Declares what is true about one corpus server. This file is the ground truth a scanner's findings are scored against; see docs/scoring.md.

server_id.description: Directory name. Prefix encodes the class it is built for; benign controls use c01..c04.

port.description: Lab port. Must match the registry in corpus/conventions.md and be unique.

authenticated.description: Whether the server requires a bearer token. False is only correct for the A6 server and for benign controls exposing no sensitive tools.

summary.description: One sentence: what this server pretends to be.

sensitive_tools.description: Tools whose invocation has side effects or discloses non-public data. Defines the A6 denominator.

declared.description: Ground truth. Every flaw deliberately planted in this server. Vulnerable servers declare exactly one class; benign controls declare none.

variant.description: A10 only: a = unrestricted execution, b = allowlist bypass.

surface.description: Where the flaw is reachable. Must match the class's surface in docs/taxonomy.md.

symbol.description: Function or tool name carrying the flaw.

field_path.description: A1/A3: the descriptor field, e.g. tools.summarize.description

line_hint.description: Advisory only. Never load-bearing for scoring.

proof_of_reach.description: A concrete input or call demonstrating the flaw is genuinely reachable. Required for A5, A8, A10.

runtime_trigger.description: A2/A4: how the runner provokes the flaw. Must be deterministic.

counterpart.description: A3 only: the server whose tool is being shadowed.

rationale.description: Why this is an instance of the class, referencing the present-when test in docs/taxonomy.md.

tolerated.description: Classes a defensible scanner might report here without being wrong. Scored as neither TP nor FP. Frozen at corpus tag time; adding one later requires a governance amendment. Keep this list short: a tolerated entry is a hole in precision.

not_applicable.description: Classes this server cannot structurally exhibit, excluded from its denominator. Derived and verified by tools/validate_manifests.py.

synthetic_credentials.description: Every credential-shaped literal in this server, registered so the no-real-credentials check can distinguish planted from leaked.
